name: OmniMemEval
summary: MemTensor's evaluation framework for memory backends (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, BEAM, PersonaMem v2, HaluMem) and memory-equipped agents on AgentBench domains.
description: Two tracks: **User Memory Evaluation** drives any memory backend through `add()` and `search()` and scores answers with configurable answer/eval LLMs; **Agent Memory Evaluation** runs agent runtimes with memory plugins (OpenClaw) on AgentBench-style domains (reasoning, information retrieval, knowledge work, code, software engineering). Ships data-preparation scripts, env templates per backend (e.g. MemOS) and published result snapshots. Third-party benchmark data keeps its upstream licenses. From the makers of MemOS.
